subject: Literature
title: Magical Realism Goes Global
description: A fast breakdown of Magical Realism Goes Global for builders.

hook.text: After García Márquez won the Nobel Prize, writers worldwide began blending the magical with the everyday.

buildup.text: Magical realism presented supernatural events as normal, forcing readers to accept a wider definition of reality.

discovery.text: Authors from India, Japan, Nigeria, and England adopted the style, each adding their cultural perspective.

twist.text: Some critics argued that Western publishers promoted magical realism to exoticize non-Western cultures.

climax.text: The movement proved that literary innovation often comes from the margins, not the established centers.

punchline.text: The world's edges reshaped its literary center.

quiz.question: What criticism has been leveled at magical realism's global spread?
options: It was too difficult for readers to understand
Western publishers may have promoted it to exoticize non-Western cultures
It was only written in Spanish
